text:
maria: Quick sync — final draft of the product launch blog is ready for review. Also created a CTA mapping doc for the blog -> webinar -> demo funnel. Need copy + guest speaker blurb + legal sign-off by EOD so we can schedule the webinar. Doc: https://docs.google.com/draft-launch-blog

sam: Uploaded final draft to the doc above. TL;DR: benchmark section uses internal throughput numbers vs baseline — sources linked at the bottom. Proposed CTAs: 'Register for the webinar', 'Request a dedicated demo', 'View benchmarks'.

lee: Hero image looks a bit off on mobile; can we switch to the 2:1 crop? I added a comp in Figma: https://figma.com/file/hero-comp

oliver: For lead routing — please confirm UTM scheme so I can map to HubSpot lists. I recommend utm_source=blog, utm_medium=blog_post, utm_campaign=launch_q2 and distinct utm_content for each CTA. Also gating the webinar will help MQL quality.

sam: Added sample UTM snippet in the doc: ```?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blog_post&utm_campaign=launch_q2&utm_content=webinar_cta```

jen: Legal quick question — the claim "2x throughput" needs a footnote pointing to the test ID. Sam, can you add test parameters (model variant, sequence length, hardware) to methodology?

sam: Yep — added a brief methodology section with test id RF-2026: model: open-encoder-v1, seq=2048, hardware=A100-80GB, batching details. Linked the eval report.

maria: Guest speaker update — we invited Riley (VectorLabs) and reached out to Dr. Patel. Riley tentatively said yes. Who will write the 2-sentence speaker blurb for the registration page?

sam: I can draft two options:
- Draft A: "Riley Gomez, Head of Infrastructure at VectorLabs, shares production inference lessons and cost tradeoffs."
- Draft B: "Riley Gomez — runs VectorLabs' infra, will share war stories on serving costs and SLOs."

lee: I prefer Draft B (more conversational) — it matches the developer-first tone.

oliver: Include Riley's LinkedIn handle on the reg page. Also need a one-line host intro for the webinar landing.

maria: I'll host. Host blurb: "Hosted by Maria Torres, Product Manager at Redwood Inference."

webinar-bot: Scheduled webinar slot: 2026-07-15 10:00 PDT. Registration page auto-created: https://events.redwood.ai/reg/1917

sam: One copy tweak: swap "Get a demo" for "Request a dedicated demo" to set expectations.

oliver: Agreed. I'll map that CTA to create a demo lead in HubSpot and send a sales-team notification.

jen: Legal approves the benchmark language with the added methodology. Minor edit: avoid absolute terms like "best".

maria: Current status check — copy (sam) ✅, design (lee) ✅, legal (jen) ✅, webinar scheduled ✅. Oliver, can you confirm lead-routing config by noon so we can push to publish queue?

oliver: On it. Will post HubSpot list IDs and a webhook sample in the doc once wired.

sam: Final ask — tone check on the intro. We want developer-first, tactical. @maria want me to soften the opener?

maria: Yes, please soften it. Make it less marketing-y and more about practical lessons.

sam: Done — updated intro and published the draft to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/launch.

maria: Great — moving to publish queue once oliver confirms routing. :rocket:

oliver: Confirmed. HubSpot list IDs posted in the doc: [12345]. Webhook URL masked. Will share a screenshot of funnel wiring in 30m.
